research_topics.mythology_and_lore: Subterranean Fae court built within the fossilized ribcage of an ancient primordial wyrm (The Ossuary Citadel). The Bone Fae draw power from osteomancy—resonating with the calcium and skeletal memories of ancient beasts. A strict blood-caste system exists where High Royals have porcelain-white bones that resist all steel, while Common Fae have brittle bone-structures.
research_topics.magic_system_rules: 1. Bone-Resonance: Prince Caelum is blind, but perceives the physical world through the vibration of living marrow and calcium. 2. Poison-Weaving: Aurelia crafts botanical nerve toxins using subterranean fungi (Pale Maiden, Ghost-Bell). 3. The Blood-Debt Betrothal: An ancient alchemical treaty requiring the vassal clan to offer a bride to the royal executioner. If the bride dies within a year, the vassal province is forfeited.
research_topics.character_psychology: Aurelia Vex (Protagonist): Cynical herbalist/poisoner. Survived by never trusting court smiles. Believes love is a fatal chemical vulnerability. Prince Caelum (Male Lead): Feared High Executioner of the court. Stoic, terrifyingly lethal, secretly protecting his younger sister from the corrupt Queen Regent. Intrigued by Aurelia's lack of fear and her immune bloodline.
research_topics.trope_pacing: Enemies-to-lovers with forced marriage. Fake alliance turns real. 'Who did this to you?' moment in Ch 14 when rival court tries to poison Aurelia. Sensual escalation: Ch 5 bath wound-dressing, Ch 12 forced royal ballroom waltz, Ch 18 first breathless kiss in the catacombs, Ch 25 explosive consummation before the coup.
